json_proto.name: san_jac_analytics

queries.sqlText: SELECT t.TERM_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT e.STUDENT_ID) AS enrolled_students, SUM(CASE WHEN e.TOTAL_SCH_ATTEMPTED >= 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS full_time_count, ROUND(full_time_count * 100.0 / enrolled_students, 1) AS full_time_pct FROM SAN_JAC_DEMO.ANALYTICS.FACT_ENROLLMENT e JOIN SAN_JAC_DEMO.ANALYTICS.DIM_TERM t ON e.TERM_ID = t.TERM_ID GROUP BY t.TERM_NAME ORDER BY t.TERM_NAME
queries.correspondingQuestion: How many students are enrolled each term, and what is the full-time rate?

queries.sqlText: SELECT s.ETHNICITY, s.GENDER, COUNT(DISTINCT s.STUDENT_ID) AS student_count, ROUND(student_count * 100.0 / SUM(student_count) OVER(), 1) AS pct FROM SAN_JAC_DEMO.ANALYTICS.DIM_STUDENT s GROUP BY s.ETHNICITY, s.GENDER ORDER BY student_count DESC
queries.correspondingQuestion: What is the demographic breakdown of students by ethnicity and gender?

queries.sqlText: SELECT t.TERM_NAME, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ca.AC_SUCCESS = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS success_rate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ca.WITHDREW = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS withdrawal_rate FROM SAN_JAC_DEMO.ANALYTICS.FACT_COURSE_ATTEMPT ca JOIN SAN_JAC_DEMO.ANALYTICS.DIM_TERM t ON ca.TERM_ID = t.TERM_ID GROUP BY t.TERM_NAME ORDER BY t.TERM_NAME
queries.correspondingQuestion: What is the A-C course success rate and withdrawal rate by term?

queries.sqlText: SELECT p.AREA_OF_STUDY, p.PROGRAM_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT e.STUDENT_ID) AS enrolled, ROUND(AVG(e.TOTAL_SCH_COMPLETED), 1) AS avg_sch_completed FROM SAN_JAC_DEMO.ANALYTICS.FACT_ENROLLMENT e JOIN SAN_JAC_DEMO.ANALYTICS.DIM_PROGRAM p ON e.PROGRAM_ID = p.PROGRAM_ID JOIN SAN_JAC_DEMO.ANALYTICS.DIM_TERM t ON e.TERM_ID = t.TERM_ID WHERE t.IS_CURRENT_TERM = TRUE GROUP BY p.AREA_OF_STUDY, p.PROGRAM_NAME ORDER BY enrolled DESC
queries.correspondingQuestion: Which programs have the most enrolled students in the current term?

queries.sqlText: SELECT fa.AID_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT fa.STUDENT_ID) AS recipients, ROUND(AVG(fa.AID_AMOUNT_AWARDED), 2) AS avg_awarded, ROUND(AVG(fa.UNMET_NEED), 2) AS avg_unmet_need FROM SAN_JAC_DEMO.ANALYTICS.FACT_FINANCIAL_AID fa GROUP BY fa.AID_TYPE ORDER BY recipients DESC
queries.correspondingQuestion: How many students receive each type of financial aid, and what is the average award and unmet need?

queries.sqlText: SELECT ds.STAGE_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ssh.STUDENT_ID) AS students_in_stage, ROUND(AVG(ssh.DAYS_IN_STAGE), 0) AS avg_days_in_stage FROM SAN_JAC_DEMO.ANALYTICS.FACT_STUDENT_STAGE_HISTORY ssh JOIN SAN_JAC_DEMO.ANALYTICS.DIM_STAGE ds ON ssh.STAGE_ID = ds.STAGE_ID WHERE ssh.STAGE_END_DATE IS NULL GROUP BY ds.STAGE_NAME ORDER BY ds.SORT_ORDER
queries.correspondingQuestion: How many students are currently in each lifecycle stage and how long have they been there?

queries.sqlText: SELECT c.CAMPUS_NAME, ce.CPD_CENTER, COUNT(*) AS enrollments, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ce.COMPLETION_STATUS = ''Completed'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS completion_rate FROM SAN_JAC_DEMO.ANALYTICS.FACT_CPD_ENROLLMENT ce JOIN SAN_JAC_DEMO.ANALYTICS.DIM_CAMPUS c ON ce.CAMPUS_ID = c.CAMPUS_ID GROUP BY c.CAMPUS_NAME, ce.CPD_CENTER ORDER BY enrollments DESC
queries.correspondingQuestion: What are the CPD enrollment counts and completion rates by campus and center?

queries.sqlText: SELECT s.PELL_ELIGIBLE, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ca.AC_SUCCESS = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS success_rate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ca.WITHDREW = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS withdrawal_rate FROM SAN_JAC_DEMO.ANALYTICS.FACT_COURSE_ATTEMPT ca JOIN SAN_JAC_DEMO.ANALYTICS.DIM_STUDENT s ON ca.STUDENT_ID = s.STUDENT_ID GROUP BY s.PELL_ELIGIBLE
queries.correspondingQuestion: How do course success and withdrawal rates compare between Pell-eligible and non-Pell students?

queries.sqlText: SELECT c.CAMPUS_NAME, t.TERM_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT e.STUDENT_ID) AS headcount, SUM(e.TOTAL_SCH_ATTEMPTED) AS total_sch FROM SAN_JAC_DEMO.ANALYTICS.FACT_ENROLLMENT e JOIN SAN_JAC_DEMO.ANALYTICS.DIM_CAMPUS c ON e.CAMPUS_ID = c.CAMPUS_ID JOIN SAN_JAC_DEMO.ANALYTICS.DIM_TERM t ON e.TERM_ID = t.TERM_ID GROUP BY c.CAMPUS_NAME, t.TERM_NAME ORDER BY c.CAMPUS_NAME, t.TERM_NAME
queries.correspondingQuestion: What is the enrollment headcount and total SCH by campus and term?

queries.sqlText: SELECT co.COURSE_PREFIX, co.COURSE_TITLE, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ca.AC_SUCCESS = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS success_rate, COUNT(*) AS attempts FROM SAN_JAC_DEMO.ANALYTICS.FACT_COURSE_ATTEMPT ca JOIN SAN_JAC_DEMO.ANALYTICS.DIM_COURSE co ON ca.COURSE_ID = co.COURSE_ID WHERE co.IS_GATEWAY = TRUE GROUP BY co.COURSE_PREFIX, co.COURSE_TITLE ORDER BY attempts DESC
queries.correspondingQuestion: What is the success rate for gateway courses?

json_proto.semanticDescription: San Jacinto College student analytics model covering credit enrollment, course success, financial aid, student lifecycle (TargetX CRM stages), continuing professional development (CPD), and demographic analysis. San Jacinto College is a large Hispanic-Serving Institution (HSI) in the Houston, Texas area with approximately 31,800 credit students across 5 campuses. The model uses a star schema with 8 dimension tables and 5 fact tables. Key metrics include enrollment headcount, full-time rate (33.8%), A-C course success rate (~72%), withdrawal rate (~12%), Pell eligibility (56%), Hispanic enrollment (63.3%), and CPD completion rates. The student lifecycle tracks stages from Prospective through Enrolled to Graduate/Alumni or Stop-Out via TargetX CRM integration.
